how_to_read.catalog_id null: No catalog entry exists for this case action. A validator error and a catalog change request.
how_to_read.note starting BLOCKING: The case cannot run without this entry.
how_to_read.note otherwise: Why the mapping is a judgement call, or what it costs.
how_to_read.unmatched_placement: Where a case action has no catalog entry, this says which tab and group to render it in so the case stays playable and the gap stays visible. Delete it once the catalog entry exists.
how_to_read.also_covers_group: Applies this case action's tag, halt reason and debrief note to every entry in the named catalog equivalence group. Use it wherever the case is making a claim about the act rather than about one specific agent, because a harmful tag on one member leaves the others as an unguarded route to the same harm.

rows.note: Formerly two case actions, niv_cpap and niv_bipap, both bound to the single catalog entry non_invasive_positive_pressure_ventilation. Because one catalog entry resolves to one case action, the second was unreachable: its tag, debrief note and references never rendered, and a scenario step naming it was silently discarded. Merged into one action whose note carries both teaching points. If the catalog ever splits continuous and bilevel into separate entries, add them to the non_invasive_ventilation equivalence group and bind this action to the group with also_covers_group, rather than reintroducing two case actions.
